harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: three groups of requests of probe.py 31. (1) f3_* - a SET UNDER THREE PREDICATES (kind ord): three `LDG.E.128.STRONG.GPU`, each under its own predicate (P0, P2, P4) and a NEGATED guard (a load executes where its predicate is false), on ONE write barrier with no wait between them, 1 and 4 cycles apart under the yield flag; ONE wait on the first of four data reader instructions, 2 cycles (_r180: 180 cycles) behind the last arming; the predicates: lll three bits of the lane (all eight combinations of executing and nullified loads inside every warp), ccc three bits of the iteration counter's hash, fff every load executes, ftt only the first, fft the first two, ttt none (the layout alone); _cold: every load reads another never-written line of the output buffer; each request in which a load executes with its positive control _ew (the wait bit behind the reader instructions); a destination register holds a marker until its load lands; six grids. (2) s5_* - the pair `LDC` + `S2UR UR, SR_CTAID.X` (kind ord, "read": "younger"): s5_same both on ONE write barrier, the reader of the S2UR's uniform register carries the ONE wait 2 cycles behind it and a reader of the LDC's register stands one cycle behind that (variant ctl: two barriers, both waited); s5_bare the LDC without a barrier; s5_same_ew* the controls with NO wait in front of the readers - the S2UR's reader 2 | 4 | 8 | 15 cycles behind it, the LDC's one cycle in front; classes stale1 = only the S2UR's reader took its marker (the LDC has landed, the S2UR has not), stale2 = only the LDC's, stale = both: a distance with stale at a nearer reader and stale1 at a farther one has the LDC's landing inside the S2UR's flight; distance = LDC -> S2UR, 1 ... 30; six grids. (3) pp_* / pg_* - a PREDICATE producer (kind raw): `ISETP.LT.U32.AND P2` (P2 holds the other value until it lands) into the predicate input of `ISETP.GT.AND P3, PT, R, RZ, P2` (pp_and) and of `ISETP.NE.U32.OR P3, PT, RZ, RZ, P2` (pp_or) - P3 reaches the checksum through a `SEL` 15 cycles behind - and into the guard of `@P2 LDS.128` of the thread's own line (pg_lds; nullified, its registers keep markers); _y: the producer carries the yield flag (a stall is then at most 11: distances 1 ... 11, 16, 20, 26 - the floor of such a request is the first swept distance behind the last wrong one); _c: the positive control (the producer's instruction behind the consumer); six grids

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

classes.good: the intended values in all 256 iterations
classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256
